# arXiv.org

> > arXiv is an open-access preprint repository for Physics, Mathematics, and Computer Science research, providing rapid dissemination of scientific findings before formal peer review.

arXiv.org is operated by Cornell University and the Simons Foundation, serving as a foundational infrastructure for scientific communication across multiple disciplines. The repository hosts millions of preprints organized by subject category, enabling researchers worldwide to share and discover cutting-edge research.

## Key Topics

- arXiv preprints

## Getting Started

- [arXiv.org e-Print archive](https://arxiv.org): arXiv homepage: open-access preprint repository for Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science
- [About arXiv](https://info.arxiv.org/about): About arXiv: mission, history, governance by Cornell University and Simons Foundation
- [arXiv Help Contents](https://info.arxiv.org/help): Help center with submission guides, account management, search, API documentation

## Astrophysics

- [Astrophysics - New](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph/new): New astrophysics preprint submissions on arXiv
- [Astrophysics - Recent](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph/recent): Recent astrophysics preprint submissions on arXiv
- [Astrophysics of Galaxies](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph.GA/recent): Recent galaxy astrophysics preprints with JWST observations
- [Cosmology and Nongalactic Astrophysics](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph.CO/recent): Recent cosmology and nongalactic astrophysics preprints on arXiv
- [Earth and Planetary Astrophysics](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph.EP/recent): Recent exoplanet and planetary astrophysics preprints on arXiv
- [High Energy Astrophysical Phenomena](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph.HE/recent): Recent high energy astrophysics preprints on arXiv
- [Instrumentation and Methods for Astrophysics](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph.IM/recent): Recent astrophysics instrumentation and methods preprints on arXiv
- [Solar and Stellar Astrophysics](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph.SR/recent): Recent solar and stellar astrophysics preprints on arXiv

## Condensed Matter Physics

- [Condensed Matter - New](https://arxiv.org/list/cond-mat/new): New condensed matter physics preprint submissions on arXiv
- [Condensed Matter - Recent](https://arxiv.org/list/cond-mat/recent): Recent condensed matter physics preprints on arXiv
- [Disordered Systems and Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/list/cond-mat.dis-nn/recent): Recent disordered systems and neural networks preprints on arXiv
- [Materials Science](https://arxiv.org/list/cond-mat.mtrl-sci/recent): Recent materials science preprints on arXiv
- [Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics](https://arxiv.org/list/cond-mat.mes-hall/recent): Recent mesoscale and nanoscale physics preprints on arXiv
- [Other Condensed Matter](https://arxiv.org/list/cond-mat.other/recent): Recent other condensed matter physics preprints on arXiv
